generated_note: Civic Graph catalog (object–link–action). Catalog only — no production writer or public route. Each object/link carries grounding built|partial|gap from the measured existence matrix. Characterization imports live allowlists and fails if a code type is missing here.

object_types.reason: Additive source-qualified generic person envelope. It preserves each source identity and has no public person route; cross-source identity requires an accepted evidence-bearing same_person link.
PASSPort and Checkbook source observations construct one aggregate procurement object through accepted exact identity edges; City Record remains stage evidence and never constructs identity.
Additive enduring institution identity. It preserves the source record and legacy agency subject; unsupported institution kind and legal form remain null.

Checkbook Spending payments retained as individual source_records-shaped rows (host collector + request-time dual-write). Kill sample 2026-08-11: usefulness 22/50 (44%), precision 31/31 (100%). Promoted to built grounding after the retention gate cleared (cg-v1).
Legistar matter 78605 is published as an exact-key static legislative matter document over the meeting-outcomes materialization; broader matter coverage remains bounded.
Recommendations are declared as source-qualified outputs of an explicit board or committee statement; production recommendation objects and edges are not materialized yet.
City Record and community-board publishers share a source-qualified meeting object; exact source keys remain available for later joins.

Agenda items are declared as source-qualified meeting content; production agenda-item objects and edges are not materialized yet. Raw agenda text remains available when no canonical matter join exists.
Roll-call rows and person-level identity are retained inside the bounded meeting-outcomes and legislative-matter projections; an independent public vote object is not yet published.
Publisher-issued Legistar BodyId is the stable identity; BodyName remains a mutable label. Membership edge publication is held until the dated authenticated sample clears its exact-key gate.

Each committed board record is one publisher-keyed civic body with a place projection and an organization projection. The source registry inventories 59 boards; governance edges remain unknown until their source inventory clears its publication bar.

has_member.semantics: descriptive temporal service on a source-qualified Community Board person; no Council official identity or vote implication

hosts_meeting.semantics: descriptive publisher-backed relation from a community board institution to a meeting; no agency, influence, control, or vote implication

issues_recommendation.semantics: a recommendation explicitly issued by the board; no adoption or implementation implication

governed_by.semantics: a board-local bylaw version governs the board only when the publisher document is retained; missing rules remain source_does_not_establish

object_types.reason: Reviewed five-borough identity table for Charter borough boards. It is a civic-institution reference, not a public roster, and never an observed recommendation.

A source-qualified version of one Community Board's governing bylaws. Versions retain effective or adoption dates when published, explicit supersession history, and material rule provenance; one board's rules never become a citywide default.

A reviewed publisher-backed committee local to one Community Board. The board-local key prevents same-named committees on different boards from becoming one institution and does not broaden the Legistar Council committee object.

considers.semantics: the committee considered a matter only when the source explicitly identifies both; agenda-text similarity cannot mint a matter

recommends.semantics: committee discussion alone is not a recommendation

object_types.reason: A source-qualified person identity local to one Community Board. It is distinct from the Legistar/Council official object and may later attach to a generic person only through an explicit reviewed assertion.
High-confidence City Record sibling stitches materialize one source-qualified rulemaking case file while retaining notice evidence.
A source-qualified agency forecast published before or apart from a formal rulemaking. Its anticipated stage is planning context and never a required proceeding stage.
Property disposition process identity (agency + BBL/tax-lot) via disposition spines; location extraction supplies geography.
Staffing exams are build-time materializations outside the ER/public graph allowlists.
Subsidy lifecycle caches per-notice stages without immutable project observations.
Franchise/concession spines exist as product joins; not a public graph node type.
